criteria.reason: Both assistants correctly calculated the volume (9.9 cubic meters) and adhered to the negative constraints by refusing to provide pallet/package counts due to unfinalized SKUs and lack of live inventory.
Both assistants accurately represented the limitations of the system regarding e-commerce, pricing, and packaging.
Assistant A provides a more progressive and helpful conversation. Assistant B repeats almost the exact same follow-up question in Turn 2 as it did in Turn 1, which stalls the conversation.
Assistant A's follow-up questions flow logically from one step of the project (formwork) to the next (timber framing). Assistant B's follow-up questions are highly repetitive across turns.

reason: Both assistants successfully adhered to all system constraints and authoritative facts, including refusing to provide pallet counts. However, Assistant A is superior because its follow-up questions are progressive and keep the project moving forward, whereas Assistant B repeats the same question about installation methods in both turns.
